comment: Web search as a user-defined tool (no built-in needed). See docs/USER_TOOLS.md. jichi passes the model's arguments as JICHI_ARG_<NAME> env vars (never on the command line), so the API key stays in your environment. Pick ONE backend below, set its key env var, and add a real model block. The agent calls this like any other tool.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return the top results (title, URL, snippet) as text. Use for current events, docs, or facts outside the codebase.
tools.comment: Tavily example. Get a key at tavily.com and export TAVILY_API_KEY. Swap the curl for Brave/SearXNG/etc. as you like; the contract is just: read JICHI_ARG_QUERY, print results to stdout.
tools.shell: curl -fsS https://api.tavily.com/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$(jq -nc --arg q "$JICHI_ARG_QUERY" --arg k "$TAVILY_API_KEY" '{api_key:$k, query:$q, max_results:5}')" | jq -r '.results[] | "- \(.title)\n  \(.url)\n  \(.content)"'
